title: serverRoute
summary: Build browser-safe proxies for server handlers.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: path is the registered route pattern. module contains only browser-safe exports. handlers selects loader/action proxies; both default to true.

sections.title: Returns
sections.body: A typed Route with remote handlers and optional client call-through.

sections.title: Usage
sections.body: Import this API from one of the entry points listed above. Keep server and build helpers in their dedicated subpaths.

sections.title: Behavior and edge cases
sections.body: Requests use /_smolter?url=... on the current origin. GET runs loader; mutation methods run action. Pass an empty handlers object for a view-only manual browser route. The generated Vite routes supply the exact server exports. JSON is the transport format; runtime validation remains application-owned.
